_authMode_comment: Who pays for the model calls. 'subscription' (default) uses the interactive claude/codex logins already on this machine. 'api' bills an API key you supply below. Per-provider overrides: anthropicAuth (claude workers), openaiAuth (codex workers) — a mix is fine. Env always wins: CAUSALSMITH_AUTH_MODE, CAUSALSMITH_ANTHROPIC_AUTH, CAUSALSMITH_OPENAI_AUTH.
_apiKey_comment: Only read in api mode. Either inline the key (this file is gitignored) or point at a file outside the repo whose first non-empty line is the key. Env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY override both.
_codexApiHome_comment: CODEX_HOME for codex api mode. Deliberately NOT ~/.codex: codex permits one login method per home and would delete the stored ChatGPT credentials. Default ~/.codex-causalsmith-api; override with CAUSALSMITH_CODEX_HOME_API.
